approval: User approved the three documented diagnostic families on 2026-10-03: Allow these documented diagnostics.

scope.diagnostic: All log messages before absl::InitializeLog() is called are written to STDERR
scope.cause: The Python extension does not initialize Abseil logging. Its first native log emits the one-time stderr preamble. This is separate from Python warnings and is unchanged upstream behavior in the chosen dependency version.
scope.fix_status: The proposed automatic initialization change was rolled back upstream; it also has documented double-initialization compatibility constraints. No local initialization policy change or warning suppression is proposed.

scope.cause: The upstream negative test and standalone control deliberately hold the listening port. The native error accompanies the correctly raised Python RuntimeError.
scope.control: 20 iterations; each correctly rejects the occupied port and completes shutdown.

scope.diagnostic: chttp2_transport.cc GOAWAY INFO for Cancelling all calls or Server shutdown
scope.cause: The transport logs nonzero HTTP/2 GOAWAY codes at INFO. The lifecycle tests intentionally cancel live calls or stop servers. The clients receive the expected outcome and subsequent successful requests remain verified.
exclusions: all other GOAWAY texts/codes and warning sites

qualification.native_valgrind: Six controls finish functionality and zero native initialization count; raw memory reports remain classified separately under existing approved startup-cache/Abseil-pool exceptions.
